messages:
liam_sales: heads-up: Zenith POC failing intermittently. Theyre using function-calls + json mode to ingest catalog rows. Sometimes the tool response is fine, other times the stream ends with stray control bytes and the client JSON parser errors with 'Unexpected token'. They also saw a few 429s when ramping to ~90 QPS. Need eng + security + pricing triage.

rohit_eng: can you paste a redacted raw chunk + request headers and model?

liam_sales: redacted snippet from their DEBUG logs:

```
{"tool":"row_extractor","items":[{"sku":"Z100","name":"Bolt"}]}}
\x00\x02

parse error at pos 256
```

headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tool-1.0-q6`, `x-client-id: zenith-900`

paula_oncall: 429s likely client-side parallelism to /v1/stream. How many workers?

liam_sales: they run 12 parallel workers.

min_ia_ml: q6 fast path can emit a short binary footer when a streaming flush races with batching; we've seen non-utf8 trailing bytes. Two actionable items: (1) add sanitizer in stream assembler to trim non-UTF8 tails and validate final char is `}` or `]`; (2) provide an opt-in fallback wrapper like {"_rw_tool_malformed":true,"raw_b64":"..."} so clients still get valid JSON and can recover payload.

rohit_eng: agree. I'll open a small change to the assembler implementing sanitizer + optional base64 fallback behind a route flag `tool_stream_fallback=base64`.

paula_oncall: plan for repro: add zenith-900 to canary and temporarily bump per-client burst tokens so they don't hit 429 while we test. I'll do the routing change.

deploy-bot: [ci 2301.5] stream-assembler-sanitize branch built. unit tests: \u2705, integration: \u2705. staging deploy queued.

paula_oncall: zenith-900 added to canary routing and burst tokens increased to 200 for 4 hours. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/integrations/zenith-900/streams (alerts set).

tom_salesops: ballpark Dedicated for their expected load (30-50k tokens/day sustained with spikes) is ~Qk/mo; reserved min 4 GPUs. I'll loop in finance and legal for a quick quote and the KMS/VPC addendum.

sophie_security: on the SQ: they asked about customer-managed HSM/KMS and EU residency (eu-west-1). Private deployments support customer KMS/HSM; Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-west-1 under enterprise contract + KMS addendum. For long-term audit retention (5-7 years) we recommend export-to-customer-archive or the extended retention add-on. I'll draft formal answers.

liam_sales: customer will repro tonight 19:30 UTC. They need a stable POC by EOW to proceed. If canary shows clean JSON + stable QPS we'll move to quote. Please post results here. Thanks!
